source_snapshot.procedure: Send in-band `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x04` on localhost. Decode status 55/56/57/58/FF/device-specific and, for 57, all eight detail bits covering SEL, SDR, FRU, IPMB and firmware corruption.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command is sent without error and response data is exactly `55 00`.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL incorrectly says the operation is not directly runnable with one stock ipmitool command and awaits exact bytes even though the same row supplies raw 0x06 0x04.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE correctly restores the exact read, strict 55 00 PASS, complete 57-bit decoding, log preservation and no automatic reset or repair.

old_problem: The historical record retained Pending for target/interface, response framing, a versioned parser and vendor interpretation of device-specific values. The standard and Master already define the command, successful payload and all standard status/detail meanings; the remaining bindings are finite execution prerequisites, not an unresolved engineering decision.
disposition_reason: Run the source's standard read-only raw 0x06/0x04 exactly once on the verified localhost in-band path, separate transport/completion success from the two-byte response payload, and PASS only exact `55 00`. Treat `56 00` as a valid not-implemented report but not PASS unless an approved platform specification first establishes that the function is unsupported and the case is formally dispositioned N/A. Decode `57 xx` bit-for-bit, and fail/escalate 58, FF or device-specific values without automated repair.
decision_basis: XLSX row 995, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 996 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 996 / variant 377142dea3d79d70.

IPMI v2.0 section 20.4 makes Get Self Test Results mandatory, permits it whenever the device is ready for commands, and defines completion plus exactly two response data bytes with 55/56/57/58/FF and device-specific semantics.

The standard says a controller without self-test returns 56; this is evidence of not-implemented capability, not evidence that the source's required `55 00` healthy result passed. ED-13 permits N/A only after the applicable platform specification proves non-support.

Pinned ipmitool implements `mc selftest` using App NetFn and Get Self Test, decodes every 57 bit and returns failure for standard 56/57/58/FF results. Its device-specific branch can return success, so neither high-level output nor process exit alone may replace the source's raw two-byte comparison.

ED-03, ED-13, ED-15 through ED-19, ED-22 and ED-28 preserve the standard raw command, exact expected result, evidence and no destructive recovery; ED-33, ED-34, ED-36 and ED-38 permit ordinary target/parser/vendor bindings without retaining Pending.

test_case.test_name: Read and strictly decode the in-band IPMI BMC self-test result
test_case.purpose: Verify the bound BMC reports a healthy self-test result over the intended localhost in-band IPMI interface, preserve the complete standard diagnostic payload for any failure, and make no BMC, log or host change.
required_package: Immutable DUT-to-BMC-to-local-IPMI-device mapping, approved in-band interface/privilege and pinned ipmitool build

Versioned raw-response parser that records transport status and IPMI completion separately, requires exactly two response data bytes and implements the complete 55/56/57/58/FF table plus all eight 57 detail bits

Approved model/firmware specification for any N/A claim and vendor addendum for interpreting nonstandard device-specific status/detail values; absence does not prevent recording a deterministic FAIL/escalation
Protected local execution or verified secret-safe host access with bounded timeout and the pinned reviewed Script revision if used
Evidence store preserving raw bytes, decoded fields, SEL/SDR/FRU correlation references and a no-log-clear/no-write/no-retry audit
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY AUTOMATION ONLY; DO NOT RUN DURING REVIEW. Bind the exact DUT, BMC and local IPMI device, prove the selected path is in-band localhost, preserve current logs and invoke the pinned equivalent of `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x04` exactly once with a bounded timeout. Record transport/tool status, IPMI completion and stdout payload separately. Require successful completion and exactly two payload bytes. PASS only `55 00`; classify `56 00` as NOT IMPLEMENTED and FAIL unless an approved platform specification supports a separate N/A disposition; decode `57 xx` into all eight named failure/unknown bits; classify `58 xx` as fatal hardware error, `ff 00` as reserved invalid-for-PASS and every other first byte as device-specific internal failure retaining its detail byte. Preserve raw and structured evidence and stop. Do not clear logs, substitute a summarized `mc selftest` result for raw bytes, reset, repair, write or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The one verified in-band request has successful transport and IPMI completion, returns exactly two data bytes, and the payload is exactly `55 00`. The parser deterministically records all other standard or device-specific results as non-PASS diagnostics without changing BMC or host state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact DUT/BMC/local-device binding, one raw 0x06/0x04 request, successful tool/transport and IPMI completion, exactly two returned data bytes and exact `55 00`. Command exit success, a text-only `Selftest: passed`, `56 00`, any `57 xx`, `58 xx`, `ff 00`, device-specific value, malformed/extra/missing data, unknown completion or stale evidence cannot pass. `56 00` becomes N/A only through a separate approved SPEC-backed disposition; missing target/parser/spec is NOT READY, not Engineering Decision Pending.
safety_gate: Allow only read-only App NetFn 0x06 command 0x04 on the verified local IPMI device; deny reset, repair, write and arbitrary raw commands.
Interpret `(IB)` from the explicit localhost procedure as in-band, not InfiniBand, and verify the DUT/BMC mapping before invocation.
Use protected local or verified secret-safe access; prohibit sshpass, plaintext credentials and host-key bypass.
Preserve existing dmesg/syslog/SEL and exact raw evidence. Do not perform the source's generic log-clear step because it would destroy fault context.
Fail closed on timeout, transport error, nonzero IPMI completion, wrong payload length, invalid status/detail pairing, non-55 result or parser ambiguity; do not retry automatically.
No recovery action is in scope. A BMC reset, firmware repair, FRU/SDR/SEL change or hardware service requires a separate approved case.
expected_evidence: DUT asset/serial, intended BMC, local IPMI device/interface and pinned tool/parser/Script versions
Timestamp, bounded timeout, tool/transport status, IPMI completion and exact redacted two-byte payload
Response-length check, status/detail interpretation and complete eight-bit expansion for a 57 result
Exact `55 00` comparison; for 56, the approved platform non-support specification if an N/A disposition is requested; vendor reference attached for any device-specific decode
Preserved fault-context logs, no-write/no-clear/no-retry audit and automation output with engineer verdict ownership
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected. On invalid, non-55 or unavailable output, retain raw bytes and logs, close the protected session and escalate to the BMC/platform owner. Do not clear SEL, reset the BMC, rewrite SDR/FRU, flash firmware, replace hardware or repeat the query automatically; any investigation or recovery is separately authorized and evidenced.

source_conflict.reason: The Master command, response map and exact `55 00` Criteria agree with IPMI. DeepSeek's no-command statement is an incorrect review assertion, not a competing source requirement.

blocked.reason: The standard fully defines the command and all standard response semantics. Target/interface, parser version and optional vendor-specific decoding are finite Project prerequisites; an unknown vendor value can still be safely classified non-PASS and escalated.
